newsitem.title: USA: American Bingo settles with Texas Lottery.
newsitem.headline: American Bingo settles with Texas Lottery.

text.p: American Bingo & Gaming Corp said on Wednesday it had reached a settlement with the Texas Lottery Commission regarding alleged violations.
The company was not immediately available to comment on the nature of the settlement.
American Bingo said in a statement the commission agreed to transfer certain company bingo licenses to four of its South Texas operations. This would let American open these centers, it said.

"We are working hard to open all of our South Texas halls as quickly as possible," Greg Wilson, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement. "We expect to have them open and generating revenues for the company and the charity conductors in the fourth quarter of 1996."
